request.initial_prompt: Returning to the room, he would usually begin doing something to amuse and comfort his precious boy; he would tell him stories, funny anecdotes, or would mimic comic people he had happened to meet, even imitate the howls and cries of animals. But Ilusha could not bear to see his father fooling and playing the buffoon. Though the boy tried not to show how he disliked it, he saw with an aching heart that his father was an object of contempt, and he was continually haunted by the memory of the "wisp of tow" and that "terrible day."

raw_segments.text: He was continually haunted by the memory of the wisp of tow.
Though the boy tried not to show how he disliked it, he saw with an aching heart
that his father was an object of contempt, and he was continually haunted by the memory
of the wisp of tow and that terrible day.

even imitate the howls and cries of animals.
But Alusha could not bear to see his father fooling and playing the buffoon.
